page.description: RetroPie for Raspberry Pi 4 and 400: the official 4.8 image, its size and a SHA-256 computed by ROMinit.
page.intro: A Raspberry Pi image that turns the board into an emulation console. This entry covers the official 4.8 image for Pi 4 and 400 only; it is not a PC image.
pros: Emulators, front end and controller setup are preinstalled.
One image for Raspberry Pi 4 and 400.
The project documents the setup for each system family.
Updates come from the RetroPie-Setup script on the running system.
cons: Raspberry Pi only: this is not a PC or x86 image.
The project publishes no SHA-256, so the hash here is computed by ROMinit.
4.8 dates from 2022; the setup script updates packages after boot.
Writing the image replaces the whole SD card or USB stick.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for RetroPie on a Raspberry Pi; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a card and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image: the official 4.8 build for Raspberry Pi 4 and 400, written to an SD card or USB stick with dd or an image writer. Writing replaces the whole card. Its SHA-256 was computed by ROMinit from the official GitHub download on 2026-10-27, not published by the project.
